I don't know if I would necessarily say I'm "hyped" for it as, while I enjoyed the first one, it didn't astound me in any aspect. That said, I'm definitely intrigued by it because the first one was by no means a bad game and if they polish the right aspects and lighten up the protagonist a bit I think they could have a great game on their hands.

I have really mixed feelings about the first one, but I think a well-made sequel could be great. The paranoia was there, but it was more of a "someone might be invading me right now" paranoia, rather than a "any one of these fucking NPCs could actually be another player" paranoia. The NPC AI was far too predictable and robotic to successfully blend into a crowd.

1) I really like the invasion-style multiplayer (hacking & surveillance), but there's definite room for improvement.

2) The driving was god-awful. Like really, really abysmal. They need to fix the driving physics, and they need to make the AI worse drivers. It's so easy to determine when another player is driving a vehicle, because the AI drives so smoothly/perfectly. It's basically impossible to imitate.

3) Like Mirror's Edge, during parts of the game where the mechanics are on point, the game shines. It's the rest of the time that's really a problem. They need to double down on the hacking/voyeurism aspects - really make them permeate the entire game. WD1 felt like a worse GTA that occasionally let me use fun hacking mechanics.

It's an interesting enough concept that I think it deserves a second chance.
